question: How are alone, paired, and mixed image-sacrifices distinguished, and by whom mixed?
premises: alone, paired, and mixed-wheel-yoked-hero-mixed forms are distinguished
the alone proceeds by the alone ones themselves
the mixed is mixed again by gurus
inference: Rite-forms divide by solitude, pairing, and guru-mixed mixture.
uncertainties: cakrayug-virasankara kept technical; guru-mixing agency open
plain_english: Alone, paired, mixed-wheel-yoked-hero-mixed — the alone by the alone indeed, mixed by gurus, again.
